blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. Section 5 of Unipay Pte. Ltd.'s binding Unitas Terms of Service explicitly reserves the issuer's right, without prior notice, to freeze, burn, or otherwise restrict USDu or sUSDu under a user's control when it believes the user violated the terms or applicable law. That exact-token issuer power is sufficient for a direct true freeze-reach finding under the access-review contract even though the currently verified BSC ERC-20 and Solana Token-2022 transfer paths themselves remain permissionless and expose no native freeze authority. The prior inherited verdict was invalid because USDU has no upstream stablecoin parent; the legal authority belongs to its own issuer.

oracleRisk.summary: USDu is issued against a protocol-managed delta-neutral reserve portfolio rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: Unitas documents whitelist-restricted minting and redemption against deposited USDC, followed by protocol-managed allocation into JLP and hedged perpetual positions. It does not document borrower-specific debt, collateral-ratio thresholds, or liquidatable collateral branches for USDu issuance.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDU has independent native deployments on BSC and Solana, each minted by the issuer on that chain (BSC owner is the reviewed 3-of-5 Safe); no live cross-chain supply route exists.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos bridge-route re-verification; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-4 (lead dai-makerdao)
